name: Site Vision AR
summary:
See your project at full scale, before it's built.

 Site Vision AR takes the 3D models you already have — and design models of your buildings and sites — and puts you inside them. Not a picture on a screen or a fly-through video, but the real thing at real size, where you can walk to a doorway and see how wide it actually is, stand in a room and feel the ceiling height, and step outside to look at the whole site from the ground.
